title: Good Photo for an Anime Portrait: Before-and-After Guide
metaTitle: What Makes a Good Photo for an Anime Portrait?
description: Learn what makes a good photo for an anime portrait, including lighting, clarity, expression, framing and selfie tips for a hand-drawn custom transformation.
intro:
The best anime transformations begin with a photo that gives an artist clear information to work from. A good photo for an anime portrait shows your face clearly, uses even lighting and captures the expression or pose you want to preserve. It does not need to be a professional studio photograph.

At Anime Cabinet, human artists draw each custom anime portrait from your uploaded reference photo. We do not apply an AI filter or automatically replace your features. Instead, your likeness becomes an original character within the visual language of your chosen style. You can choose from 24 anime and cartoon styles, including [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer), [Ghibli Style](/portraits/ghibli-style), [Naruto](/portraits/naruto) and [One Piece](/portraits/one-piece). Preview artwork arrives within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included so you can request adjustments before approving the final piece.
